newsitem.title: POLAND: Missing Dutch travellers found dead in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Missing Dutch travellers found dead in Poland.

text.p: Two young Dutch people who had been missing for months were found dead in a Polish forest and had apparently killed themselves, a prosecutor said on Friday.

Janusz Ohar, spokesman for the prosecutor's office in Krosno, said the bodies of a woman aged 30 and a 27-year-old man had been discovered on Wednesday seated in a wooden shelter in the Bieszczady wilderness region of southeastern Poland.
They were holding hands and had masks and plastic bags over their faces, PAP news agency reported Ohar as saying.
"According to preliminary conclusions they both committed suicide," Ohar told the agency.
The agency did not report their names, but their passports identified them as the missing couple.
Ohar said the two, last seen in late February in a nearby village, had written to tell their parents they planned to kill themselves.
An official at the Netherlands embassy in Warsaw said he was aware of the report but declined to comment.
